# Festival evidence fixture

`festival-evidence-v1.json` is a byte-for-byte copy of `src/assets/data/festival-effect.json` from Travel-project commit `f25dc8673420c451d3fdb4482fce5feb00a485f1` (SJbranch).

SHA-256: `b1d4fc0fbe702c517d791e6c9724ae5be1a8a8d709c5ad789a96864a28736c9d`.

It tests the proposed DB import contract against the actual checked-in artifact. It is not a production seed, a fresh statistical rerun, or independent validation of the original raw inputs. The source code and provenance limitations are documented in `docs/supabase-database-design.md`.
